source_summary: Horizontal ink-and-light-color Chinese landscape with a left rock cliff, distant low riverbanks, travelers in the foreground, and a right-side grove of pines and autumn trees beside a rocky water edge. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: left_cliff_wall
motifs.description: Isolate the large vertical rock cliff on the left, including its stepped upper ledge, pale gray wash face, dark angular contour lines, dry-brush cracks, small vertical grass strokes on the top, and the bare shrub rooted on the lower left face. Exclude the nearby travelers and calligraphy/seal marks.
must_preserve: dark broken outline along the cliff rim
gray and tan wash texture on the rock face
dry-brush crack marks and ink scumbles
small bare shrub branches at lower left
tiny upright grass strokes on the cliff top

motifs.name: distant_riverbank_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the long, low band of distant hills and riverbank running across the middle distance, with thin horizontal ink lines, soft gray washes, and faint undulating silhouettes fading into open mist.
must_preserve: misty broken edges with blank paper gaps
subtle darker accents along the ridge

motifs.name: porter_with_load
motifs.description: Isolate the walking attendant at lower left carrying a shoulder pole with hanging basket and bundle, including the small hat, gray robe, bent legs, thin pole line, and hanging objects. Exclude the cliff and mounted rider.
must_preserve: small dark hat and head details

motifs.name: mounted_scholar_on_donkey
motifs.description: Isolate the seated traveler riding a small donkey, including the peach-colored robe, dark hair knot, saddle forms, donkey ears, legs, tail, and sparse grass-like strokes around the hooves. Exclude the porter and surrounding ground wash except immediately attached hoof marks.
must_preserve: donkey head, ears, and muzzle lines
small dry-brush ground marks under the animal

motifs.name: twisted_pine_group
motifs.description: Isolate the right-center group of leaning pines with tall twisting trunks and clustered needle foliage. Include the main bent trunk, adjacent slender pine trunks, dark starburst needle clusters, bark wash, and expressive branch joints. Exclude the pink-blossomed trees behind it.
must_preserve: twisted tan-gray trunks with dark ink edges
leaning silhouette of the main pine
dark clustered foliage at multiple heights

motifs.name: autumn_blossom_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the grove of slender deciduous trees on the right with bare black branches and pale orange-red autumn leaf dots. Include the tall gray trunk, branching silhouettes, thin saplings, and scattered warm leaf clusters, but exclude the pine needles and foreground rocks where possible.
must_preserve: fine twig networks and sparse lower branches

motifs.name: right_rocky_bank_shrubs
motifs.description: Isolate the rocky bank beneath the right grove, including rounded stones, low earth mounds, dotted moss texture, small dark shrubs, the tiered conifer-like shrub near center, and pale ground washes. Exclude tree trunks except unavoidable roots at the base.
must_preserve: rounded rock outlines with gray wash
root-like dark accents at tree bases

motifs.name: foreground_water_edge
motifs.description: Isolate the pale foreground water and shoreline wash across the lower center, including the broad blank water area, soft gray bank contours, rippled dry-brush texture, and scattered stones near the left-center edge. Exclude seals, borders, figures, and the right rocky bank.
must_preserve: broken ink accents along the bank

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
